The successful candidate will prepare case management reports, manage beneficiary data, and maintain confidentiality. This position requires collaboration with various stakeholders and a commitment to a survivor-centered approach. Candidate Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in a community work related field 1-2 years of experience in the humanitarian field Experience with governmental and international organizations Excellent word processing and typing skills in English and Arabic Experience with Excel and databases Fluency in English and Arabic, both spoken and written Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued.
